purpose: Replace one-step pulse registration with a readable approach, observation, cadence alignment, sustained resonance, visible tissue response, release, and settle loop while keeping the next route closed.

stages.guideLine: A cadence knot has formed where the returned memory meets the combward tissue.
stages.objectiveLine: Move close enough to let the knot read your presence.
stages.nextAction: Approach the bright knot at the base of the combward strands.

stages.guideLine: The knot is listening. Answer once so its rhythm becomes visible.
stages.objectiveLine: Pulse once to reveal the cadence.
stages.nextAction: Press X once while near the cadence knot.

stages.guideLine: Do not strike at random. Answer when the ring flashes gold.
stages.nextAction: Pulse when the cadence ring reaches its bright gold beat.

stages.guideLine: The knot has accepted your timing. Keep the resonance alive without forcing it.
stages.objectiveLine: Hold resonance until the tissue fully answers.
stages.nextAction: Hold LT near the knot. X remains pulse.

stages.guideLine: The response is full. Release it and let the tissue settle into memory.
stages.objectiveLine: Release LT and remain nearby while the response settles.
stages.nextAction: Release LT. Do not pulse or move away until the rings settle.

stages.guideLine: The Chorus remembers how you approached, answered, aligned, sustained, and released.
stages.objectiveLine: Layered resonance complete. The next route remains closed in this pass.
stages.nextAction: Hold the completed reading. Inspection camera work comes next.
